components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The violet control that advances the review.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; color: #FFFFFF; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #6A62C8 0%, #554EAD 100%); font-family: Satoshi, Tajawal, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(85, 78, 173, 0.25); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #433C96; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #554EAD; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Bar Pill
components.description: The ink pill in the top bar.
components.css: .ds-bar { display: inline-block; background: #110B19; color: #FFFFFF; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: Satoshi, Tajawal, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-bar:hover { background: #433C96; } .ds-bar:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #554EAD; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Mode Toggle
components.description: Two-way pill for Log in and Sign up.
components.css: .ds-switch { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; background: #F4F4F7; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-switch button { border: 0; background: transparent; border-radius: 999px; padding: 10px 12px; color: #5C5968; font-family: Satoshi, Tajawal, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; } .ds-switch-on { background: #FFFFFF; color: #110B19; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(17, 11, 25, 0.06); }

components.name: Field
components.description: Paper field with a line border and a violet focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font-family: Satoshi, Tajawal, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #353E60; } .ds-field span { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid #E2E2E2; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px; color: #353E60; caret-color: #554EAD; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #554EAD; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(85, 78, 173, 0.15); }

narrative.overview:
The page sits on a cool gray field. The working surface is one white shell, split in half, taken from the SaaS project management login screen. One half holds the sentence and the control. The other half is a violet mesh with a single white card floating on it. That card is where the work is shown: the agent trace, the batch, the thing a person has to sign.

This is a readiness desk for one synthetic UAE tenant, in English and Arabic. The shell is the same object on every screen. A form, a review list, and an approval all live inside it. The interface does not file, pay, or send an invoice.
keyCharacteristics: Cool gray field, one white shell, a soft offset shadow
Split: reading and controls on one half, a violet mesh and a floating card on the other
Violet for the action that advances the review, ink for the small session pill
Navy for reading text, a darker gray than the shot's pale chip for secondary sentences
Pill toggles, 12px fields, a 48px primary button
English left-to-right and Arabic right-to-left, with the mesh half moving to the opposite edge

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Violet is the color of the control that moves the review forward. Ink is only the small pill in the bar. Bronze is only a problem. Do not paint a pass, a chart, or a headline in a second saturated color.

rules.name: The Readable Gray Rule
rules.body: Secondary text is muted (#5C5968). Do not set body or placeholder copy in #A4A2AC.

rules.name: The LTR Figures Rule
rules.body: Amounts, identifiers, dates, and email addresses set left-to-right in Satoshi. The sentence around them follows the page direction.

rules.name: The One Sentence Rule
rules.body: The display line is one sentence. A wrap is the same sentence, not a second claim.

rules.name: The Opposite Half Rule
rules.body: The mesh and the floating card always occupy the half opposite the headline. Translating the words without moving that half is a broken layout.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: A screen has the shell and, on the mesh, one card. Do not stack a card on the form half. Lists inside the shell are flat rows with a line, not more shadows.

rules.name: The Pill Or Twelve Rule
rules.body: A control that switches mode, or that lives in the top bar, is a pill. A control that submits a field is 12px, the same radius as the field. Do not mix those two radii on one control.

dos: Do keep the page on field (#F4F4F7) and the work inside one paper shell.
Do put the headline and the form on one half and the mesh with one floating card on the other.
Do use violet (#554EAD) for the control that advances the review, and bronze (#A2684A) for a failed rule or an escalation.
Do set Arabic in Tajawal and move the mesh half to the left. Keep emails, amounts, and identifiers left-to-right.
Do show missing evidence at the same size as a pass. "To verify" is a status, not a footnote.
Do label synthetic data in the label size wherever an identifier is on screen.
donts: Don't return to the earlier near-black field, glass cards, or cobalt chips. That theme is retired.
Don't copy the reference product's name, its chat about homepage structure, or its outside-account logos. Those buttons stay disconnected.
Don't use violet as a wash behind the whole page. The mesh stays inside its half.
Don't show a compliance badge, a rating, or a savings figure the run did not compute.
Don't translate Arabic by flipping strings only. The floating card changes halves.
